report.title: Hybrid text + image retrieval
report.description: Late fusion combines scores from separate indexes (never mixing vectors from different spaces); 'early' blends CLIP text and CLIP image query vectors. The text weight is tuned on the tuning split and applied once to the evaluation split. Δ is the paired bootstrap difference against the better single signal on the evaluation split (mAP for Imagewoof, R@1 for Flickr30k).

tables.title: Imagewoof val: breed name + exemplar image (primary metric mAP)
Flickr30k test: caption + 15-25% fragment, 31K gallery (primary metric R@1)
